newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Sage completes buy of U.S. life assurer.
newsitem.headline: Sage completes buy of U.S. life assurer.

text.p: Sage Group Ltd said on Friday it had completed the acquisition of U.S. life assurer The Fidelity Standard Life Insurance Co., through which it is initiating its expansion into the U.S life assurance market.
Fidelity Standard is a Delaware-registered life insurance company that writes general life insurance and fixed and variable annuity business in every state but New York.
"The formalities of the transaction have been completed and the necessary regulatory approvals granted, and the acquisition is now unconditional," Sage said in a statement.

Sage said the purchase and initial capitalisation of Fidelity Standard, which has assets worth $450 million, would be funded from offshore. Sage in February raised $30.3 million when it placed offshore 5.82 million shares or 4.8 percent of its equity capital.
Sage said it planned to establish a strategic partnership with a U.S. institution to provide enhanced financial ratings and selected outsourced services and/or distribution facilities.
It also intended to establish a New York-based subsidiary of Fidelity Standard.
